name: Math-Equivalent Constraint Substitution
description: Replaced the explicit set {1, 2} and product condition x*y=2 with mathematically equivalent but non-standard properties: "positive integers whose number of divisors equals the integer itself" (which only 1 and 2 satisfy) and "sum of cubes equals 9" (which only 1^3 + 2^3 satisfies). This forces the LLM to deduce the domain and binary constraint rather than pattern-matching "product is 2" directly to bipartite coloring.
